decision: Exclude the unreferenced standalone path-search implementation from the selected core build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte and describes itself as adapted from COMMAND.COM path-search code.
No retained core source or frozen selected dependency edge references inc/path.asm.
The kernel build assembles the distinct dos/path.asm, while the COMMAND build uses path1 and path2; all remain in their original locations.
limitations: Exclusion applies to the selected three-component build, not to other utilities that might use this standalone source.
